hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in pnpm-lock.yaml|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/.output/*) echo "Refusing to edit $f: generated artifact — regenerate via pnpm install / pnpm build instead." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
[ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; out=$(pnpm compile 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; echo "Type errors above — fix before finishing." >&2; exit 2; }
